label: preserve
contract: The result has exactly one count per bin, len(edges) - 1 in all, including bins that receive no values.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([], [0, 10, 20]) == [0, 0], histogram([], [0, 10, 20])
assert histogram([15], [0, 10, 20]) == [0, 1], histogram([15], [0, 10, 20])
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([], [0, 1, 2, 3]) == [0, 0, 0]
assert histogram([1, 2.5, 7, 7.5, 9], [0, 5, 10]) == [2, 3]

label: inferable
contract: Bins may have different widths, and each value is counted in the bin given by the actual edges.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
got = histogram([0.5, 1.5, 4, 9], [0, 1, 2, 10])
assert got == [1, 1, 2], got
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([1, 3, 3, 50], [0, 2, 10, 100]) == [1, 2, 1]
assert histogram([0.1, 0.2, 0.9], [0, 0.5, 1000]) == [2, 1]

label: arbitrary
contract: Each bin includes its lower edge, so a value equal to an edge (other than the last edge) is counted in the bin that starts there.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([3], [1, 3, 5]) == [0, 1], histogram([3], [1, 3, 5])
assert histogram([1], [1, 3, 5]) == [1, 0], histogram([1], [1, 3, 5])
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([5, 0], [0, 5, 10]) == [1, 1]
assert histogram([2, 4], [0, 2, 4, 6]) == [0, 1, 1]

label: arbitrary
contract: A value equal to the last edge is counted in the last bin.
visible_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([20], [0, 10, 20]) == [0, 1], histogram([20], [0, 10, 20])
heldout_check:
from binning import histogram
assert histogram([10], [0, 5, 10]) == [0, 1]
assert histogram([6, 6, 1], [0, 3, 6]) == [1, 2]

label: arbitrary
contract: A value below the first edge or above the last edge raises ValueError.
